purpose: Form AOC-1 is used to provide the statement containing the salient feature of the financial statement of a company's subsidiary or subsidiaries, associate company or companies and joint venture or ventures under the first proviso to sub-section (3) of section 129.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the statement containing salient features of financial statements of subsidiaries, associate companies, and joint ventures.
Ensure the statement is in e-Form AOC-1 as required under the first proviso to sub-section (3) of section 129.
checklist: Salient features of financial statements of subsidiaries
Salient features of financial statements of associate companies
Salient features of financial statements of joint ventures
watch: Ensure compliance with the first proviso to sub-section (3) of section 129.
